definitions.explanation: A very large number of people, animals, or things gathered or moving together.

examples.japanese: ⟦イワシ→イワシ：10718_iwashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大群|たいぐん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{現|あらわ}れた→現れる：01870_arawareru⟧。
examples.english: A huge school of sardines appeared.

examples.japanese: ⟦バッタ→バッタ：06515_batta⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大群|たいぐん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{農地|のうち}→農地：14354_nouchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{襲|おそ}った→襲う：01915_osou⟧。
examples.english: A swarm of locusts attacked the farmland.

examples.japanese: ⟦{観光|かんこう}→観光：00173_kankou⟧⟦シーズン→シーズン：10944_shiizun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{大群|たいぐん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{島|しま}→島：00885_shima⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れる→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧。
examples.english: When tourist season arrives, throngs of tourists visit this island.

notes:
Composed of {大|たい} (large) + ⟦{群|ぐん}→群：02790_gun⟧ (group, flock). Used for impressively large numbers of living things — animals, insects, people — or sometimes objects. The word emphasizes the sheer scale of the group.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{蝶|ちょう}→蝶：04288_chou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大群|たいぐん}: a swarm of butterflies
- {大群|たいぐん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{押|お}し{寄|よ}せる→押し寄せる：06733_oshiyoseru⟧: to swarm in; to descend in large numbers
- {大群|たいぐん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧: a large group/swarm appears

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{群|む}れ→群れ：00298_mure⟧: group; flock; herd — more neutral in size
- ⟦{集団|しゅうだん}→集団：03211_shuudan⟧: group; mass — more organized, often used for people
- ⟦{群衆|ぐんしゅう}→群衆：14930_gunshuu⟧: crowd; throng — specifically a crowd of people
